Reason: The provided CT images (Figures 2 and 5) demonstrate a large, heterogeneous mass occupying the left hemithorax (specifically involving the lower/ posterior regions) and a distinct nodule in the left lower lung field. This radiological appearance of a substantial left-sided recurrence is most consistent with option C, which describes a recurrence in the left lower lung field that is larger than an initial upper lung field presentation. Options suggesting right-sided involvement or a normal chest are contradicted by the clear left-sided pathology visible in the scans.
